## Five-axis review

- [ ] Correctness and regression risk
- [ ] Readability and maintainability
- [ ] Architecture and boundaries
- [ ] Security and data exposure
- [ ] Performance and operational impact

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets or local environment files included
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior
- [ ] Pre-existing failures are documented separately
- [ ] Diff contains no unrelated changes
- [ ] Commit(s) are atomic and use Conventional Commits
- [ ] Push, merge, deployment, and PR actions have explicit approval
